values.note: ReserveAmerica, up to 9 months ahead, same day included; DEC's 2026 summary sets a 1-night reservation minimum here. A permit runs at most 14 nights, and from July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights are allowed at any campground. Register by 9 pm on the first night or the site is re-rented.

summary: Confirmed $18 + $5 non-resident (DEC 2026 summary), 2027 season May 14 - Oct 10 (matches), ReserveAmerica 9-month window and 14-night max (DEC row, now on the entry), 1-night reservation minimum. Added 66 sites to 40 ft (mostly 40-ft grassy back-ins), no electric, showers, dump. AWH note kept. Not stated: water at sites.
